primary_source: National population and housing censuses and population registers, harmonized by CIESIN for about 13.5 million national and sub-national administrative units.
primary_source_evidence: Producer metadata: estimates 'consistent with national censuses and population registers' allocated with 'approximately 13.5 million national and sub-national administrative Units'. The producer distributes the product under CC BY 4.0.
